text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Download(x, y) ::: y downloads x.
Share(x, y) ::: y shares x.
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Karen(y) ::: y is Karen.
BlackMirror ::: the show Black Mirror.
Premises:
NetflixShow("Black Mirror") ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
Popular(x) → BingeWatch(x, Karen) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
BingeWatch(x, Karen) ↔ Download(x, Karen) ::: If and only if Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download("Black Mirror", Karen) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
BingeWatch("Black Mirror", Karen) → Share("Black Mirror", Lisa) ::: If Karen binge-watches "Black Mirror", she will share it to Lisa.
Conclusion:
Popular("Black Mirror") ::: "Black Mirror" is popular.
